paper.title_en: Quantum effects of charged massive scalar fields on charged black hole space-times
paper.abstract_en: We compute the renormalized expectation values of the scalar condensate, charge current and stress-energy tensor for a massive charged quantum scalar field on a Reissner-Nordstrom black hole. The mass of the scalar field is sufficiently large that classical superradiance is absent. We present results for the Boulware, Unruh and Hartle-Hawking states. Renormalized expectation values in the Hartle-Hawking state are computed using an efficient and accurate mode sum prescription, and for the other two states we employ state subtraction. The efficiency of our numerical method enables us to explore a large part of the parameter space, including near-extremal black hole charges and scalar field masses close to the superradiant limit.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文计算了带电黑洞上带电标量场的量子效应，属于黑洞热力学相关领域，方法新颖且计算高效。
decision.title_zh: 带电黑洞时空上带电有质量标量场的量子效应
decision.abstract_zh: 我们计算了Reissner-Nordstrom黑洞上带电有质量量子标量场的标量凝聚、电荷流和应力能量张量的重整化期望值。标量场的质量足够大，以至于经典超辐射不存在。我们给出了Boulware、Unruh和Hartle-Hawking态的结果。Hartle-Hawking态中的重整化期望值使用一种高效且精确的模和处方计算，对于其他两个态，我们采用态相减。我们的数值方法的效率使我们能够探索参数空间的大部分区域，包括近极端黑洞电荷和接近超辐射极限的标量场质量。
